" type="audio/mpeg" /></audio>
</aside>


<script id="youtube-playlist-config">
// Coller ici le lien de la liste YouTube non répertoriée de Thomas, au format https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=...
const AUDIO_THERAPIE_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST = '';
(function(){
  const url=AUDIO_THERAPIE_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST.trim();
  try{
    const u=new URL(url);
    if(!['www.youtube.com','youtube.com','m.youtube.com'].includes(u.hostname)||!u.searchParams.has('list')) return;
    const block=document.getElementById('yt-room-block');
    const link=document.getElementById('yt-room-link');
    link.href=u.href;block.hidden=false;
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>


<script id="ambience-script">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const ambience=document.getElementById('ambience-audio');
  const button=document.getElementById('ambience-play');
  const status=document.getElementById('ambience-status');
  const more=document.getElementById('ambience-more');
  const controls=document.getElementById('ambience-controls');
  const vol=document.getElementById('ambience-volume');
  const percent=document.getElementById('ambience-percent');
  const catalog=document.getElementById('catalog-player');
  const video=document.getElementById('session-video');
  let requestedVolume=0.22;
  let playRequested=false;
  let explicitlyPaused=false;
  function refreshVolume(){
    const otherPlaying=(catalog&&!catalog.paused)||(video&&!video.paused);
    ambience.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,requestedVolume*(otherPlaying?0.25:1)));
    percent.textContent=Math.round(requestedVolume*100)+' %';
  }
  function refreshButton(){
    const playing=!ambience.paused;
    button.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Écouter';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));
    status.textContent=playing?'Lecture en boucle · 90 BPM':(playRequested&&!explicitlyPaused?'Touchez Écouter pour lancer':'Musique en boucle · 90 BPM');
  }
  async function start(){
    playRequested=true;
    explicitlyPaused=false;
    try {await ambience.play();} catch(e) {refreshButton();}
  }
  button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(ambience.paused) start();
    else {explicitlyPaused=true;ambience.pause();}
  });
  more.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const expanded=more.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true';
    more.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(expanded));
    controls.hidden=!expanded;
  });
  vol.addEventListener('input',()=>{requestedVolume=Number(vol.value)/100;refreshVolume();});
  ambience.addEventListener('play',refreshButton);
  ambience.addEventListener('pause',refreshButton);
  ambience.addEventListener('error',()=>{status.textContent='Audio indisponible : vérifier le dossier media';});
  [catalog,video].forEach(el=>{if(el){el.addEventListener('play',refreshVolume);el.addEventListener('pause',refreshVolume);el.addEventListener('ended',refreshVolume);}});
  refreshVolume();refreshButton();
  // Lecture automatique tentée. Les navigateurs peuvent exiger un clic pour autoriser le son.
  start();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
